As Chevron New Com (CVX) Share Price Declined, Holder Stralem & Co Has Trimmed Position; Peak Asset Management Continues to Hold Position in Gilead Sciences (GILD)
May 21, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Peak Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Gilead Sciences Inc (GILD) by 73691% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Peak Asset Management Llc bought 73,691 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.93% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 73,791 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.29M, up from 100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Peak Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Gilead Sciences Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.44 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.62% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $68.02. About 5.42M shares traded. Gilead Sciences, Inc. (NASDAQ:GILD) has risen 9.79% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.76% the S&P500.
Stralem & Co Inc decreased its stake in Chevron Corp New Com (CVX) by 23.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stralem & Co Inc sold 30,450 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.26% with the market. The institutional investor held 97,195 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.17M, down from 127,645 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stralem & Co Inc who had been investing in Chevron Corp New Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $244.34B market cap company.
